supportPolicy: One Spark optionally reveals or skips one non-graded Practice question. Free instruction and retries never require Sparks. No official mastery or grade is awarded for using a Spark.
includedExpiryRule: Included credits expire 60 days after their qualifying membership period ends, subject to the controlling member terms.
purchasedExpiryRule: Purchased Sparks do not expire under the current proposed credit policy.
